description: This file provides a utility function to parse UTF-8 encoded byte arrays into strings, with optional error handling for invalid UTF-8 sequences. It uses the TextDecoder API and manages singleton instances for fatal and non-fatal decoders. It also includes import of external error handling class.

classes.name: TextDecoder
classes.description: Type defining the TextDecoder API used to decode UTF-8 byte arrays.

classes.name: TextDecoderConstructor
classes.description: Type defining the constructor for TextDecoder objects, parameterized with 'utf8' label and options.

methods.name: parseUtf8
methods.description: Decodes a segment of a Uint8Array to a string, either fatal or non-fatal depending on the parameter, and throws a BSONError if invalid UTF-8 is detected in fatal mode.
